pricing_detail: Free plan $0/month (10k notifications/mo, no card); Essentials from $100/month billed annually; Business and Enterprise tiers

name: Edgegap MCP
description: Edgegap's official MCP server lets AI coding agents deploy and run multiplayer game servers on Edgegap's edge hosting network. From the editor, an agent can push server builds, start and stop deployments, check matchmaking and fleet status and read logs, so game developers can manage their online backend in plain language.

name: Jev
description: Jev is an open-source chat assistant for Android, Windows and macOS that reads the conversation on your screen, judges what the other person wants and whether a message looks risky, and drafts candidate replies for you. It fills in the reply box, but you always decide whether to send, so it helps with tricky messages without acting on its own.

name: Waku
description: Waku is a native desktop app that gathers your local coding agents in one place. It shows sessions from Amp, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok and Pi on a single timeline that stays entirely on your machine, so you can follow and switch between agent runs without juggling terminals.

name: Paritok
description: Paritok is a compression gateway that sits between a coding agent and its LLM. Using its own open-source 4B code-aware model, it shrinks tool output, files and conversation history on the fly without losing what the agent needs, which cuts token bills and lets agent sessions run longer before they hit context limits.

name: Rome OS
description: Rome is an open-source agent OS for recursive agents that compounds what they learn. Agents build their own tools, keep context and reuse capabilities across tasks instead of starting fresh each time, so a long-running assistant grows more capable the more it works.

name: TapQ
description: TapQ is an always-on voice layer for the coding and work agents you already run. You talk to Claude Code, Codex and others through your earbuds, interrupt them, steer the work and hear spoken updates, so you can supervise agents hands-free while away from the keyboard.

name: nanocode
description: nanocode is a small SDK for embedding frontier-model agents inside your own apps and tools. It provides the agent loop, tool calling and session handling for models such as Claude and GPT in a compact codebase, so developers can ship a capable embedded agent without adopting a heavy framework.

name: 0.security
description: 0 is an open, self-improving AI operating system for offensive security work. Its agents investigate code and binaries for vulnerabilities, test defenses, verify findings with working proofs and help fix the issues, and the team behind it publishes the advisories it has found in real open-source projects.

name: agent-manager
description: agent-manager is a terminal app built on tmux for running many AI coding agents at once. It shows live status for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Grok, Cursor and other sessions in a foldable project tree, adds a quick prompt bar, and has a diff reviewer whose line comments are sent straight back to the right agent, on macOS, Linux and Windows.

name: mu
description: mu is an open-source coding agent with a judgment kernel: a small, fast judge model makes the many routine decisions in each turn so the main model only gets the context it needs. It ships as a command-line tool and a desktop app and aims to keep coding sessions focused and cheap.

name: Streamkap MCP
description: Streamkap's official CLI and MCP server let AI agents manage real-time change-data-capture pipelines on Streamkap. An agent can create and edit sources, destinations, pipelines and transforms, check their status and troubleshoot lag, streaming database changes into warehouses and apps without clicking through the console.
pricing_detail: Free plan $0 (500 MB/month, MCP server included); paid plans priced by data volume

name: Agente Smart Documents
description: Agente Smart Documents turns a finished Word document into a reusable template your AI agent can fill. You upload an example, it builds the template, then ChatGPT or Codex, Claude, Grok Bot, Hermes or the web workspace asks only for the details that are missing and hands back a filled .docx with the original layout kept, for you to review before sending. A few documents are free each month, then a flat monthly fee per office.

name: CutBay
description: CutBay is a chat-based AI video agent that turns ideas, web links, documents, slides, spreadsheets and your own media into finished videos. You describe what you want and it drafts explainers, product demos, slideshows, animated charts, talking-head clips or YouTube Shorts, then lets you keep editing by chat, with add-ons such as B-roll and automatic subtitles.

name: only-cli
description: only-cli (oc) turns any website into a compact command-line view for AI agents. It distills a page into short text with numbered actions that agents like Claude Code can follow and click through, so agents browse the web using a small fraction of the tokens raw HTML or screenshots would take.

name: Vidmoat
description: Vidmoat is a hosted AI video editor you direct in chat. Describe the edit and its agent cuts dead air, adds word-synced captions, grades and reframes your footage on a real timeline, where you can review and change any cut by hand before rendering an MP4. It works in the browser, on Telegram (@vidmoat_bot) and over MCP (https://api.vidmoat.com/api/mcp, OAuth), so Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can drive edits too.
pricing_detail: Hobby $0 (no card, 40 AI credits/mo, 720p with watermark); Creator $19/mo; Studio $49/mo; Team $29/seat/mo (min 3 seats); day passes from $2.99

name: SalesTouch
description: SalesTouch is a LinkedIn MCP server for AI agents. Connect Claude, Codex, ChatGPT or any remote MCP client to https://www.salestouch.io/api/mcp and your agent can find prospects, research people and companies, send invitations and messages, and handle follow-ups through 45 purpose-built LinkedIn tools instead of browser automation. Scoped OAuth, approvals for sensitive actions, daily limits, working hours and a human-paced action queue keep the account under control.
pricing_detail: $39/month or $389/year; 7-day free trial (card required, no charge before day 7); one LinkedIn account included

name: Vellm
description: Vellm turns photos of people and pets into short AI videos from ready-made templates. Pick one of 108 dance, funny, duo and pet templates built on ByteDance Seedance 2.5, upload your photos and it renders your own version, or start from a prompt in its Create Studio. A remote MCP server (https://api.vellm.app/mcp, OAuth sign-in) lets MCP-compatible AI apps create videos from your Vellm account.
pricing_detail: One-time credit packs from $4.49 (50 credits, one video) up to $39.99 (600 credits); monthly plans $20.99 (350 credits) and $41.99 (700 credits); templates cost 50-100 credits; no free trial

name: Crolytics
description: Crolytics is a managed, governed AI workspace for B2B marketing and go-to-market teams, hosted on Google Cloud. Its agents connect to your CMS, GA4, Search Console and knowledge base through custom MCP connectors, answer analytics questions in plain language, track how AI assistants cite your brand (GEO/AEO), and draft or update website pages behind human approval gates, with per-person permissions and a tamper-evident audit log. Teams use it from the Crolytics chat or inside their own Claude or ChatGPT account.
pricing_detail: Growth $5,000/month (managed and run for you, no per-seat or usage pricing); Enterprise custom; every plan starts with a free 2-week pilot after a scoping call

name: DIRI AI
description: DIRI AI is a voice role-play trainer for salespeople. You pick a situation, such as a price objection, an intro meeting, a cold call or a client who wants to leave, set the difficulty, and talk out loud with an AI customer that reacts to what you actually say rather than a fixed script. After each call you get an instant report with a transcript, the key moments highlighted and specific stronger wording to try next time, plus a history of your practice. Managers can use it to help new hires ramp up before real calls.
pricing_detail: Free €0 (no card): 1 voice call a day, up to 5 minutes, with a full report; Start €19.90/month (80 min), Plus €49.90/month (240 min), Pro €99.90/month (480 min); 7-day free trial on paid plans (card required)
good_for: sales teams practising calls, onboarding new reps, objection handling

name: Fileaify
description: Fileaify is a project workspace that plugs into the coding agent you already use, such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Windsurf. You give the agent one URL (fileaify.com/agent) or the hosted MCP connector, approve its access, and it finds the project's documentation, architecture decisions, roadmap and known issues in each new conversation, so you don't have to explain the project again, even when you switch agents. Credentials stay in a vault: the agent can run approved actions with them without ever seeing the keys, sensitive actions need a human's approval, and paid tiers add a sandboxed executor where the agent can actually run work. The agent also writes its contributions back into the project docs, following your review rules. A live demo project lets you try it without installing anything.
pricing_detail: Free €0 (1 project, 5 services and secrets); Solo €4.90/month; Pro €14.90/month; Premium €39.90/month; Enterprise on request
good_for: coding agents that need project context, secrets kept out of prompts, human-approved access

name: img2threejs
description: img2threejs is an open-source agent workflow that looks at a reference image and rebuilds the object in it as a procedural Three.js model written purely in code. Each model goes through quality gates before it is accepted, comes out ready to animate, and is built in a token-efficient way, so a coding agent can turn photos or concept art into live 3D scenes without any mesh files.

name: Waggle
description: Waggle shows which files an AI agent actually opened before it answered. Instead of pasting whole documents between agents, it hands over short references that can be traced back to the source, so you can check whether an answer was grounded in what you gave the agent and send it back when it skipped the reading. It plugs into agent harnesses over MCP.

name: Strands Decider
description: Strands Decider is a small, fast decision model from Strands Labs for agent workflows. Rather than asking a full LLM every time, an agent can use it to choose between options or score something on a scale in a fraction of the time, with calibrated confidence so the workflow knows when to fall back to a bigger model.

name: Decionis
description: Decionis is an approval gateway for actions taken by AI agents. It sits in front of consequential API calls such as payments, price changes and orders, checks each one against your policy before it runs, and only lets it through with a single-use permit, keeping a signed record of every decision for audit.

name: Foremerge
description: Foremerge is an open-source coordination layer for teams of coding agents, built on top of Git. Each agent keeps its own worktree, but they share what they intend to change, claim the parts of the code they are working on and verify each other's change sets, so conflicting plans are caught before they turn into merge conflicts. It also works over MCP.

name: CodeAF
description: CodeAF is an open-source software factory from AgentField built to run on open models. It ships ready-made specialist agents you call with slash commands, one to build features like a senior developer, one to audit code for security issues and one to review GitHub pull requests, and spreads the work across a pool of models to balance cost and quality.

name: Kition
description: Kition is an open-source desktop office workspace with an AI agent built in. It combines documents, data tables and a whiteboard for design work in one app, and its tool-using agent can research the web, write and translate, organise records and produce editable brand assets, with visual workflows to chain the steps together.

name: BeefTV
description: BeefTV is an open-source, local-first desktop workspace for making AI video. On a free-form canvas you connect footage, images, generation models and agents into one flow, so you can go from an idea to finished clips without hopping between tools. It runs on macOS, Windows and Linux.

name: Aletheore
description: Aletheore audits code repositories and backs every finding with evidence. Its deterministic scanner looks for leaked secrets, vulnerable dependencies and dead code, it can watch live endpoints and draw architecture maps, and it reviews pull requests automatically through a GitHub Action. A built-in MCP server lets coding agents run the same audits.

name: Tura
description: Tura is an open-source agent runtime focused on cutting LLM spending. It manages the context an agent sends to the model so tasks use far fewer tokens, while keeping the finished results, execution evidence and benchmark scores auditable, which makes it aimed at teams running agents at scale.

name: PartMode
description: PartMode is open-source parametric 3D CAD that runs in the browser and is built to be driven by both people and AI agents. You can create multi-part designs and assemblies with lofts, sweeps and mates, browse a shared parts library, and export to STEP, STL, AMF or 3MF, while a command-line interface lets agents make permissioned changes. No account is needed.

name: Machinist
description: Machinist is an open-source software factory for coding agents. It runs agent jobs on your laptop, a virtual machine or a Kubernetes cluster, connects to GitHub so you can review the changes they make, and automates routine repository upkeep such as dependency bumps and fixes, with evals to check the results.

name: Concord
description: Concord lets coding agents message each other and work together in a shared workspace. Agents running in different tools or on different machines can hand off tasks, ask each other questions and review each other's code in real time through its MCP server, so a team of agents can coordinate without you copying messages between terminals.

name: JSON2Video MCP
description: The official JSON2Video MCP server lets AI agents produce videos through the JSON2Video API. An agent can render a movie from a JSON description, check on render status, validate the JSON before sending it and use ready-made templates, which makes it a fit for automated video production at scale; a free credit allowance is included.

name: ClicData MCP
description: ClicData's MCP server connects its data platform to AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT. You ask about churn, revenue or pipeline in plain language and get real analysis, live charts and full dashboards built from the governed business data you already keep in ClicData, which suits mid-sized teams without a data engineering group.

name: Shadeform
description: Shadeform is a marketplace for on-demand GPUs across more than 30 cloud providers, now with an official CLI and MCP server. AI agents can compare prices, launch and manage GPU instances and scale inference through one API, instead of you signing up to each cloud separately.

name: SecureAuth MCP Authority
description: SecureAuth MCP Authority is a security gateway for the MCP tool calls agents make. Every call is checked against the person the agent is acting for, using that person's own login and rules down to individual arguments, and each decision is logged so enterprises can see and control what their agents are allowed to do.

name: SimpleBackups MCP
description: The official SimpleBackups MCP server lets AI assistants such as Claude, Cursor and Codex manage your backups. From a chat you can check the status of server, database and storage backups, dig into failed runs and set up or automate backup jobs on your SimpleBackups account.

name: ChatAcademia
description: ChatAcademia is a set of AI research agents for academics. Its agents search many scholarly databases, pull insights out of papers and help with each step from forming an idea to drafting a publication, and a desktop app can work directly with the research documents on your own computer.

name: EnhanceWizard
description: EnhanceWizard is a browser-based AI image enhancer and upscaler that sharpens, unblurs, denoises and restores photos at original size, 2x or 4x. Its free browser tier processes images locally on your device up to 16 MP (8,192 px per side) with no sign-up, daily limit or watermark; optional cloud credits unlock Standard HD batch jobs up to 10 images and AI Retouch.
pricing_detail: Free $0 (no card, unlimited local browser processing up to 16 MP with no watermark); 50-credit pack $9 (one-time, valid 12 months); Monthly $12/month (100 credits/month)
good_for: upscaling and sharpening photos in the browser, restoring old or blurry photos, private local image enhancement

name: Pudding
description: Pudding is a desktop AI workspace from Teatak for macOS and Windows 11 that connects your own model API keys or local Ollama models with a built-in browser, file and command tools, a Studio for Markdown documents and typed tables, scheduled tasks, parallel subtask delegation and MCP plugins. Every tool call is shown in the conversation with per-project permission controls (Ask, Auto or Full access).
pricing_detail: Free desktop app for personal and commercial use (no account required; agent core Apache-2.0); model providers and external services charge separately
good_for: running models with a built-in browser and file tools, delegating parallel subtasks, local Ollama or BYOK desktop workflows

name: Orbi
description: Orbi is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) software factory for GitHub repositories. When you label a GitHub Issue ai-ready, Orbi implements it in an isolated worktree, opens and reviews pull requests in a separate AI review session that checks acceptance criteria and repairs failing tests, merges the exact reviewed commit SHA, and cuts a tagged GitHub Release when a human applies the ai-release label.
pricing_detail: Self-hosted: free and open source (AGPL-3.0 or Sustainable Use License, bring your own model); Cloud: 3 free merged deliveries (no card), Solo $24/month (400M tokens, 1 repo), Pro $66/month (1.2B tokens, 5 repos)
good_for: turning GitHub Issues into reviewed and merged pull requests, automated code review and repair, shipping tagged GitHub releases

name: Sora2 Hub
description: Sora2 Hub is a third-party multi-model web studio (not affiliated with OpenAI) for generating AI images and videos from text prompts or reference images. It brings together 10+ video and image models—including Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling AI, Runway, Hailuo 2.3, GPT-4o Image, Flux Kontext and Nano Banana Pro—alongside a prompt library and 2,000+ visual effects.
pricing_detail: Free starter access on sign-up; Basic $9.99/month ($7.99/month billed yearly, 1,000 credits); Pro $49.99/month ($39.99/month billed yearly, 5,000 credits); Ultra $99.99/month ($79.99/month billed yearly, 10,000 credits)

name: Whirl

name: BoardUI
description: BoardUI is a React design system for building agentic products and data-heavy dashboards, with 85 components and blocks (including chart cards), Tailwind CSS styling and fully editable source. The free set ships with a working AI chat app example, and Pro templates add ready-made layouts, so teams can put a polished interface on an agent quickly.

name: Elephant-Goldfish Model
description: Elephant-Goldfish Model is an open-source method and plugin from Google for spec-driven development with AI coding agents. A deep-context agent drafts the design, then fresh zero-context subagents stress-test that spec for gaps and wrong assumptions before any code is written, which catches problems that a single long-running agent tends to miss.

name: Open Analytics

name: Doory

name: PiG

It keeps Pi's behaviour and extension model while shipping as a single fast Go binary, so you can run the same minimal, hackable coding agent without a Node.js runtime.

name: OpenClip
description: OpenClip is a free, open-source floating action bar for macOS that pops up when you select text. From it you can copy, calculate, transform text, run AI actions or trigger your own scripts and workflows, so quick jobs on any selection take one click instead of a trip to another app.

name: Gufo

It serves models through an API so local agents can use them, and image and video generation support is in progress.

description: Dessa AI is a real-time voice chat and text-to-speech studio: talk out loud with a lifelike AI voice that you can interrupt mid-sentence, or paste a script and download natural speech as a WAV file, with 46 voices across 39 languages and paid monthly plans billed by the seconds you use.

name: Edit Image Text Online
description: Edit Image Text Online replaces or fixes text inside JPG, PNG and WebP images, such as typos, event dates or prices, while matching the original font, colour and background, so you can update posters, menus and screenshots without the source file; one free edit, then one-time credit packs with no subscription.

name: Ploutos
description: Ploutos is an AI community manager for Discord servers that welcomes new members, answers repeat questions, handles tickets and escalates to humans when needed, with a human team supervising it around the clock; plans start at $7.99 a month plus a one-time setup fee.

name: Staffly
description: Staffly gives small Shopify and Etsy sellers a ready-made AI team (a store manager, a bookkeeper, a social media poster and a review responder) that handles daily busywork while the owner approves anything customers will see; founder pricing starts at $75 a month.

name: FounderOmni
description: FounderOmni bundles founder tools for SEO and GEO, web analytics, social publishing, email, forms, scheduling, e-signatures, links and affiliates into one workspace, and exposes them to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants through an OAuth-protected remote MCP server.

name: anon.li
description: anon.li is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) privacy suite for email aliases, end-to-end encrypted file drops and forms, and its OAuth remote MCP server lets Claude, Cursor and other agents manage aliases, recipients and drop metadata without ever seeing encrypted content.

name: Petpedia AI Doctor
description: Petpedia AI Doctor is a multilingual AI assistant for everyday cat and dog health questions that keeps private pet profiles, photos and a running memory of past consultations, and gives careful triage advice on when to see a vet; registered users get five free consultations a day.

name: AI Image to Video
description: AI Image to Video animates a still photo into a short clip: upload an image, describe the motion and compare models such as Seedance, Kling, Veo and Wan to make social clips, ads or effects, with monthly credit plans from $9.99.

name: EditablePPT
description: EditablePPT converts slide screenshots, PNG or JPG images and PDFs into editable PowerPoint files by separating text, photos, icons, cards and background into layers you can change and download as PPTX.

name: Scapesome
description: Scapesome is a browser-based 3D aquarium planner for planted tanks: place real rocks, plants and fish in a 3D layout, preview growth with AI renders and check stocking and substrate before you buy, with a free plan and calculators.

name: Froging AI
description: Froging AI is a browser studio that creates AI videos from text or photos with models such as Kling, Veo, Seedance and MiniMax, generates and edits images and offers one-photo video effects, all paid from a single credit balance.

name: AI Floor Plan
description: AI Floor Plan turns a written description or an uploaded sketch into a floor plan in seconds, helping homeowners, designers and agents lay out rooms and optimise space without CAD skills, with a free trial and downloadable drawings.

name: AI Trend Video
description: AI Trend Video puts you into viral AI video trends from a single photo, or lets you upload any clip, pick 4 to 15 seconds and turn it into your own reusable template with the original sound, with no prompts or editing; one-time packs start at $9.99 per HD video.

name: Domain Search King
description: Domain Search King is a free AI domain name generator that checks every suggested .com, .ai and .io at the registry so taken names are filtered out, and it offers a remote MCP server so AI assistants can run registry-checked name searches.

name: TheRouter.ai
description: TheRouter.ai is an OpenAI-compatible AI gateway that adds health-aware routing, automatic failover, billing visibility and team governance on top of model providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and DeepSeek, with per-token pricing published for each model.

name: Else
description: Else is a pay-per-job AI agent: hand off research questions, reports, spreadsheets or a whole website, set a spending limit, and get the finished result with an itemised receipt instead of paying a subscription or buying credits.

name: ImageSVG
description: ImageSVG converts raster images into editable SVG vectors and connects to ChatGPT as an app over MCP, so you can vectorise a generated or attached image inside the chat and download the SVG, with a small free daily allowance.

name: EluxAI
description: EluxAI's AI Receptionist is a voice agent for Canadian businesses that answers every call, books appointments, takes messages, routes urgent calls and places promised callbacks, alongside AI texting and email assistants; pricing is set after a free assessment.

name: Let's Pick My Car MCP
description: Let's Pick My Car offers sourced Indian car-buying data (variants, specs, comparisons, price estimates and buying calculators) through a REST API and an MCP server, so apps and AI assistants can answer car questions with structured facts; the free beta includes 50 credits a month.

name: WhaleBlip
description: WhaleBlip is a Chinese-language crypto market intelligence site that tracks large Hyperliquid perpetual-futures positions, liquidations and funding rates in real time, adds Polymarket prediction-market data and AI-translated news, and shows only on-chain data without trading calls.

name: SPIRITT
description: SPIRITT is an autonomous AI workspace for founders and teams: its agent has its own cloud computer and memory, connects to more than 1,500 integrations, and learns workflows to build internal tools and run recurring work around the clock, via web, desktop and a Chrome extension.

name: Real Extent
description: Real Extent prepares email replies and follow-ups for real estate agents in the agent's own voice, collects buyer conversations that need attention in one place, and sends nothing until the agent approves it; a seven-day pilot is free, then plans start at $19 a month.

name: TrueScope
description: TrueScope is a mobile business suite for trade contractors, fabricators and field service companies with blueprint takeoffs, ERP and MRP, work tickets and invoicing, plus a REST API and agentic features that let AI agents work with job data; $20 per full user a month after a 30-day trial.

name: Celebrity Kitchen AI
description: Celebrity Kitchen AI makes a 15-second vertical comedy video from two portrait photos, casting you and a co-star as the coffee maker and milk pourer in a kitchen mishap scene, with no prompt needed and pay-once credits at $6.99 per video.

name: Noteboxd
description: Noteboxd is a social perfume encyclopedia where fragrance fans log, rate and review scents, and it offers a free remote MCP server at mcp.noteboxd.com so AI assistants can look up perfumes, notes and community data.

name: Está no Ir for Bots
description: Está no Ir for Bots is the machine-readable companion of a Portuguese travel notebook, publishing short 1 to 3 day European trips by train, boat, plane and on foot through a remote MCP server and a read-only A2A endpoint for AI agents (content only, not a booking agency).

name: GSD Core
description: GSD Core is a spec-driven development and context-engineering framework that runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents through a discuss, plan, execute, verify and ship loop, doing heavy research and execution in fresh-context subagents to avoid context rot.

name: Mika
description: Mika is an open-source on-device AI agent for Android that operates your apps and the web on a hidden background screen, so it can read chats, compare products or fill forms from one sentence while you keep using your phone, and it stops to ask before paying.

name: MCP Atlassian
description: MCP Atlassian is an open-source MCP server for Jira and Confluence that works with Atlassian Cloud and Server/Data Center, letting Claude, Cursor and other agents search, read, create and update issues and pages with API or personal access tokens.

name: LongHorizon-Harness
description: LongHorizon-Harness wraps Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or DeepSeek Harness in a plan, act, verify and checkpoint loop so computer-use agents can keep working on one goal across desktop apps and the terminal for dozens of hours and recover after failures.

name: MEX
description: MEX gives engineers and their coding agents shared project memory stored as Markdown in a .mex folder that travels with Git, with a local hub for people, CLI and skills for Claude Code and Codex, an MCP server and checked statechart explanations.

name: Muesli
description: Muesli is a native macOS app for Apple Silicon that does on-device dictation and bot-free meeting transcription, pastes text at your cursor and turns transcripts into notes or task plans, with a plugin so ChatGPT and Codex can use your meetings.

name: Relaticle
description: Relaticle is an open-source, self-hostable CRM built for AI agents: Claude, ChatGPT or your own model connect over its MCP server or REST API to read, write and analyse companies, people, opportunities and tasks, with custom fields and workspace isolation.

name: Nexting
description: Nexting is a remote control for the coding agents on your own Mac or Windows PC: view live Claude Code, Codex, Grok or Cursor sessions, send tasks and drive them from the iPhone app or a $129 wearable PIN, with an open-source devices SDK and an optional $29/month Plus plan.

name: ChatCut
description: ChatCut is an AI video editor for agents: its MCP server and plugins let Codex, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and others edit your footage, add captions, remove silences and filler words, create motion graphics, generate voiceovers and music and export an editable timeline.

name: Phone Harness
description: Phone Harness is a remote MCP server that gives Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP clients a real cloud iPhone or Android emulator to see the screen, tap, type, swipe and open apps, with OAuth sign-in and no local Mac or adb setup.

name: Tracekit
description: Tracekit checks every tool call an AI agent makes before it runs, signs each call and policy decision into a tamper-evident hash chain with optional witnesses, and produces one verifiable file per run, so you can prove what the agent did and whether it was allowed.

name: Babysitter
description: Babysitter is an orchestration layer for coding-agent workforces: you define a workflow in code and it enforces every step, requires quality gates and human approval at breakpoints, and records every decision in an immutable journal.

name: AnyModelBot
description: AnyModelBot is an open-source, local-first personal AI agent app for Windows, macOS and Linux where each bot has its own persona, model, workspace and memory, reachable in the app or chat apps, and it can work files, commands and your desktop with any model on pay-as-you-go billing.

name: Pullboard
description: Pullboard is a spec-driven coordination board that lives in your Git repo: many coding agents claim work in separate lanes and build from a spec you approved, a second agent verifies every change, and you answer questions and approve from one board.

name: Converly AI Voice Agents
description: Converly builds AI voice agents for businesses in Spain that answer phone calls 24/7, forward urgent calls to your mobile and, on higher plans, book appointments and work in Spanish and English; monthly plans start at 39.99 EUR for 50 minutes, with setup fees on larger tiers.

name: WordRadar
description: WordRadar is a keyword radar for indie SEO builders that flags brand-new search terms as they first appear in a 1M-word ledger, watches new Hacker News launches and Google Trends risers, and scores SERP difficulty, all served over a REST API and an MCP server so coding agents can research niches; credits from $19, with free starter credits.

name: AI Story Writer
description: AI Story Writer helps parents turn a small idea, such as a favourite toy or a holiday, into a personalised illustrated storybook for their child, asking one question at a time to shape the plot and then producing pages you can read together and keep.

name: AI Kissing Video Generator
description: AI Kissing Video Generator turns one or two uploaded photos into a short HD video of the two people kissing, with free generations without a watermark and paid credits for more; meant for playful couple and fan edits with consent from the people pictured.

name: Remove Moire
description: Remove Moire cleans moiré patterns, screen-door lines and halftone artifacts from photos of screens, scanned prints and fabrics with an AI model, and also offers a video descreen mode; try it free, then monthly plans from $5 or one-time packs billed per processed image.

name: GAL
description: GAL (General Agent Loop & Executor) is a self-contained agent runtime shipped as a single binary for Linux, macOS and Windows that you drive from a CLI, desktop app, browser, chat apps or HTTP, with a kernel-enforced sandbox and scoped one-time authorizations so every agent step is contained and auditable without Docker, Python or Node.

name: Overdrive Lab
description: Overdrive Lab is a digital social media agency run by a team of connected software agents that research topics, draft posts, review them and publish to your linked channels, while you set direction and approve work; built-in scheduling rotates approved content, currently through a founding beta.

name: BeatAPI
description: BeatAPI gives AI agents one key for discounted LLM, image and video model APIs, more than 1,000 data APIs (X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit), web search and production workflows, available over REST and MCP so an agent can add capabilities without juggling separate providers; pay per use.

name: Jev API
description: Jev API returns fast, typed decisions for software: you send state and the possible outcomes, and it answers with a choice, a yes/no or a score plus probabilities, so apps and agents can make routine judgments without a full LLM call; a free jev-1.13 tier is available and paid access runs through BeatAPI.

name: 1ZheAI
description: Independent usage-based AI API service for developers building coding assistants, text workflows and image applications. Supports selected OpenAI-compatible integrations; model and feature availability depend on the endpoint. Requires an account, API key and balance. Check live model prices and billing notes before use. USDT top-ups supported. Not affiliated with model providers.

name: Put Me In
description: Put Me In turns one to five of your photos into a 10 to 15 second AI video of you acting out a trending meme template such as Tiny Desk, Hotel Lobby or Gangnam Style, ready to download from your videos page; priced per video from $4.99.

name: TattooGen AI
description: TattooGen AI generates four original tattoo designs from a text idea or a photo in about 20 seconds, then lets you try a design on your own skin, make a stencil for your artist or plan a cover-up; free with Google sign-in, with a $4.99 one-time pack or monthly plans for print-ready 2K files.

name: ImageToExcel
description: ImageToExcel uses AI OCR to turn photos, screenshots, scanned documents and PDFs that contain tables into editable Excel spreadsheets, keeping rows and columns intact, with extra tools for image-to-text and finance documents such as statements and invoices.

name: AITranscribe
description: AITranscribe converts Facebook videos and Reels, Instagram videos and uploaded audio into clean text transcripts and timestamped SRT or VTT subtitle files, with a translation mode and privacy-friendly processing after sign-in.

name: Virvy
description: Virvy is an AI video and image studio built around trending effects: upload a photo or write a prompt and pick from about 20 video models such as Seedance, Kling and Veo plus image models, paying with one-time credit packs from $9.99 that never expire or a monthly plan.

name: Radarkit
description: Radarkit tracks how your brand appears in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI answers across 50+ countries, with local and shopping radars, ads tracking, LLM referral traffic and agents for outreach and content, plus an MCP and API; free trial available.

name: TokenHot
description: Tokenhot is a unified, OpenAI-compatible LLM API gateway for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and 30+ other providers, advertised at well below official per-token prices, with a playground, console and pay-as-you-go billing and no subscription.

name: Pomelu
description: Pomelu is an unofficial iPhone and Android app for Hermes Agent by Nous Research that connects to your own self-hosted Hermes gateway, giving one chat per bot with live answers, visible tool activity, approvals, voice messages and file sharing.

name: TrackAIMentions
description: TrackAIMentions runs a free AI visibility check that asks ChatGPT-style models and Perplexity five organic questions about your category and shows whether they recommend your brand, list a competitor first or skip you, with sample reports, methodology notes and paid monitoring for agencies.

name: AirBuild
description: AirBuild is an AI app builder for native iOS apps in which a team of specialised agents writes the app and then handles App Store Review for you, submitting, answering reviewer feedback, fixing and resubmitting; free with your own key, Pro $20 and Max $200, currently via waitlist.

name: AI Video Generator
description: AI Video Generator turns a single photo into a short viral-style video using trend templates such as dances, transformations and Tiny Desk, plus image effects, with refunds for failed runs; credit packs from $6.99 and monthly plans from $24.90.

name: Jersey Generator

name: Rezloom
description: Rezloom tailors your resume to a specific job description by pulling evidence from your own career library, keeping every claim traceable to real experience, producing matching English and Chinese versions, and sharing through public, private or expiring links you can revoke.

name: Dime Dime Baby AI
description: Dime Dime Baby AI turns one adult photo into a short vertical dance-inspired party-entrance video in the style of the Dime Dime Baby trend, in 480p or 720p without audio so you add the sound when posting; one-time credit packs from $9.90.

name: Genjutsu AI
description: Genjutsu AI turns a single portrait photo into a short motion clip using six templates such as Neon Rain or Red Smoke Entrance, with no source video or prompt needed; one-time credit packs from $9, about $1.37 per 5-second 720p video, and refunds for failed runs.

name: FaceTiers
description: FaceTiers is a free in-browser face-analysis test that measures 478 facial landmarks such as canthal tilt, jaw angle and facial thirds and gives a 1 to 8 score without uploading your photo; an optional one-time $9.90 PDF plan is written by AI from the measurements only. For adults 18+.

name: Ponytail
description: Ponytail is an MIT-licensed skill for Claude Code and other coding agents that makes them write like a terse senior engineer: only the code a task needs, without cutting validation, error handling, security or accessibility; its published benchmark on 39 tasks reports roughly half the code, time and tokens while more risky logic ships with tests.

name: UI UX Pro Max
description: UI UX Pro Max is an open-source agent skill that gives coding agents design intelligence for web and mobile UI, with a design-system generator that reasons over your product type and outputs matching styles, colour palettes, font pairings, layout patterns and UX rules for many frameworks.

name: Caveman
description: Caveman is an Apache-2.0 skill and proxy for coding agents that cuts tokens by making the agent answer in clipped "caveman" prose and read less context, while keeping code exact; it reports about a third fewer input tokens in Claude Code sessions and offers an Auto mode and a hosted Caveman Cloud.

name: Agent Skills (Addy Osmani)
description: Agent Skills by Addy Osmani packages senior-engineer workflows and quality gates as skills for AI coding agents, with nine slash commands such as /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review and /ship that walk an agent from idea to production with tests and review at each step.

name: Taste Skill
description: Taste Skill is an MIT Agent Skill that pushes coding agents to build polished company websites instead of generic landing pages, enforcing one design system, plain copy, real photos and brand icons, restrained motion, and a browser-based checker and finish gate that verify the rules before a page is done.

name: Impeccable
description: Impeccable gives coding agents a design vocabulary: install it into a project and steer with commands such as polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, and catch typical AI-generated design clichés before they ship; works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Copilot, Gemini CLI and more.

name: Archify
description: Archify is an Apache-2.0 agent skill for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode that turns an idea, plan or whole codebase into an interactive HTML diagram you can explore, follow source links through and share, from repository maps to learning paths and travel plans.

name: Kortix CompanyOS
description: Kortix CompanyOS is an open-source, cloud-native agent harness for companies: always-on agents start from schedules, webhooks, app events or team messages, run in parallel swarms on their own persistent cloud computers with shared company memory, connect to 3,000+ apps and land changes through team-approved reviews.

name: Ekko Studio
description: Ekko Studio (formerly Hermes Studio / Hermes Web UI) is a local-first desktop app and self-hosted web console for multi-agent chat, coding and visual workflows, supporting Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent and 14 coding-agent integrations including Claude Code and Codex, with group chat, voice, files and human approval gates.

name: Refly
